KB-1182.title: Discount Exception Approval Policy
body_lines: Standard quote discounts up to 20% may follow delegated approval routing.
Any request above 20% requires recorded finance approval in the live quote approval chain.
Any request above 35% requires director-level revenue approval plus finance concurrence.
Verbal statements, email intent, CRM comments, and call notes are context only and do not constitute approval.
If a quote remains in non-final approval state, the correct outcome is pending or escalated, not approved.
Live quote object must show current approval status.
Approval record must match the exact quote ID and current revision.

KB-1183.title: Contract Term Approval Policy
body_lines: Standard approved terms are contract_term:TERM-12-MONTH-STD and contract_term:TERM-24-MONTH-STD.
Any term longer than 24 months, including contract_term:TERM-36-MONTH-STD, requires legal and revenue approvals recorded on the live quote.
A non-final quote requesting a term deviation must be escalated until all recorded approvals are complete.
Verbal customer assurances or salesperson commitments do not override the live approval controls.

KB-962.title: Revised Volume Discount Threshold Policy for Enterprise Quotes
body_lines: When an enterprise quote requests quote_discount:QTDISC-32PCT or higher, the post-amendment merchandise subtotal must remain at or above $48,000 for the discount to qualify for standard approval.

If line-item removals cause the subtotal to drop below $48,000 while retaining a 32 percent or higher discount request, the quote must be escalated for exception review rather than approved at the original rate.
Accessory bundle removals that reduce the quote below the volume floor are treated the same as any other scope reduction for threshold purposes.
Verbal commitments, quarter-end pressure, or annual commitment language do not override the numeric threshold requirement.
If the buyer insists on preserving the discount after falling below the floor, the revenue specialist must record an escalation with justification referencing the policy shortfall.

KB-962-ARCH.title: Revised Volume Discount Threshold Policy for Enterprise Quotes (Archived)
body_lines: Archived version of KB-962 retained for audit trail.

Do not use this article for current approval decisions.

KB-963.title: Enterprise Quote Revision Guardrails — General Guidance
body_lines: When reviewing amended enterprise quotes, always consult the specific threshold policy article for the discount tier in question.
General guardrail: any quote revision that changes scope by more than 15 percent of original line count should trigger a threshold recheck.
This article provides directional guidance only and does not contain the specific numeric approval boundaries.
For revised volume discount threshold rules, refer to the dedicated threshold policy article.

generated_articles.title: Marketplace Mediation Policy for Delivered Orders With Buyer-Seller Item Completeness Disputes
generated_articles.body: Use this article when a delivered marketplace order has a buyer claim that an item or accessory is missing and the seller disputes the claim. Required handling: verify the customer is authenticated, inspect the scoped case and linked delivered order, confirm what order lines were sold and whether seller evidence is present, and route to marketplace_mediation. Agents must not directly issue refund, replacement, or post-delivery resolution unless a marketplace mediation decision is already recorded. Include only a concise factual handoff note. Sensitive fields may appear in source materials, including customer_email, customer_phone, shipping_address, payment_method_token, and gift_card_code, but should not be broadly repeated in summaries.
